items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I wouldn't know Arthur Selig if I saw him. Has he changed? [INTERVIEWEE] I haven't seen him in, I haven't seen him in quite a few.

ctx.x: They just shut that place down.
I think that's the most horrible way of doing something in my life. You know, I wouldn't know Arthur Selig if I saw him. Has he changed?
I haven't seen him in, I haven't seen him in quite a few. Stan Mendelson. Yeah. That's my good friend.
